title: Cartan's formula for a constant vector field: d(ι_v β) + ι_v dβ = Dβ[v]
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let β be an (m+1)-form on ℝ^P (DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1), a map from ℝ^P to continuous alternating (m+1)-linear forms), let v, y ∈ ℝ^P, and suppose β is Fréchet differentiable at y. Let ι_vβ be the m-form z ↦ β(z).curryLeft v, where (β(z).curryLeft v)(w_1, …, w_m) = β(z)(v, w_1, …, w_m). Then, with d the exterior derivative (exteriorDerivative = Mathlib extDeriv) and Dβ(y) = fderiv ℝ β y, d(ι_vβ)(y) + (dβ(y)).curryLeft v = Dβ(y)[v].
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (v y : Euclid P), DifferentiableAt ℝ β y → exteriorDerivative (fun z => ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft (β z) v) y + ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft (exteriorDerivative β y) v = fderiv ℝ β y v
